head.semanticHolePolicy: zero unless an item-specific contract explicitly declares a filled replacement rather than an aperture

face.semanticHolePolicy: only declared true lens apertures; every undeclared enclosed hole rejects

neck.semanticHolePolicy: zero unless category config explicitly declares otherwise

back.semanticHolePolicy: per-layer and union topology from category config
back.defaultBackVisibility: visible with foreground tail/body occlusion preserved

aura.defaultBackVisibility: rear/front are pose-authored in every declared visible cell

knownImplementationGaps.wardrobePreviewErase: preview stacks rear/base/patch/front but does not apply erase or frontErase
knownImplementationGaps.runtimeAuraModularLayers: PetAvatar currently skips aura redraw preload/composition and keeps aura in legacy placement
knownImplementationGaps.batchFrontEraseAuthoring: runtime/publisher accept frontErase, but the batch solver does not independently author or verify one
